name: Pellam the barber
desc: Pellam keeps a chair in the corner of Madelia's shop, and a sharp pair of shears. For a few hundred shillings he will give you a new cut, or a new colour.

name: Tobin the crier
desc: Tobin cried the news in Jasper's square long ago, wrapped against the cold with a bell at his belt. The museum's portal still seems to remember him.

name: Wenhal
desc: Wenhal kept old Marion's memory, back when it was a village of fishermen and herb-gatherers. The museum's portal still seems to remember him.
